Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ProcessBoundaryConstraintEvidence extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, unit-safe evidence for one process-boundary constraint at one completed operating point.

Physical values and margins retain their engineering unit. getScaledViolation() is the only dimensionless quantity and is formed with the explicit positive getResidualScale().
